ValidationRule.description: Prevents lowering a ticket's priority once assigned. Escalating to a higher priority (e.g., Medium to High) remains allowed; downgrading (e.g., High to Medium or Low) is blocked to preserve the integrity of the urgency classification.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Priority__c), OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Priority__c), "High"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Priority__c, "High"))), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Priority__c), "Medium"), ISPICKVAL(Priority__c, "Low")) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Priority cannot be downgraded once assigned. If this needs to change, contact your supervisor.
